name: Xuan & Ink
rationale: A contemporary interpretation of warm fibrous xuan-inspired paper and pressure-shaped ink. Generous blank space carries the mathematical text; an off-centre brush sweep, jade botanical gestures and small vermilion seals provide identity. It is an artistic interpretation, not a claim of historical authenticity. Icons have individual ink geometry and functional silhouettes rather than a shared decorative badge.

mastery.unknown: Closed scroll: the material has not yet been opened.
mastery.partial: A rooted stem with one closed bud: the first understanding has formed.
mastery.clear: An open flower and two leaves: understanding can be articulated.
mastery.mastered: A branching stem with two flowers and a vermilion seal: understanding transfers and can be used independently.

rendering: 132 role bodies occupy a 24-unit viewport. A narrow warm-paper edge keeps ink legible when a component has a dark surface. Asset artwork contains no external image, font, script, animation or filter dependencies.
